heading: What sound does to the body.
paragraph: Vibration helps the body move out of a high-alert state and into a slower, steadier rhythm. You can feel the change: breath deepens, held muscles soften, and attention stops racing.

notes.label: Breath
notes.title: Short, shallow breaths turn into slower, fuller cycles.

notes.label: Muscles
notes.title: Tension you've been holding starts to let go.

notes.label: Attention
notes.title: Focus takes less effort and settles back into the body.
